{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Keddek''''' was a title held by the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] leader of [[Hjaff]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Tarc]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Individuals were elected to the position every ten Hjaff (eight standard) [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. [[Visacc]] was a ''Keddek''.
